interactionRule: two pointer taps commit by interval; stutter and late answers refuse; Enter, Space, and the beat control use deterministic intervals; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases

temporalRupture: material fault memory, facet reorientation, and path-order memory -> bounded beat ledger whose interval band changes non-local mark roles
mediumRupture: filled compound bodies and sparse SVG paths -> a score-like SVG register with path-bearing marks and a causal rail
renderer: deterministic inline SVG delayed temporal score
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
